name: Sales Tax Nexus Tracker
short_description: Monitor rolling sales by state, track threshold verification dates, organize registrations, and calendar filings with CPA-ready handoffs.
long_description: A practical operations kit for US remote sellers shipping into multiple states. Includes an operating guide, a four-sheet Excel workbook with rolling-total and aging formulas, and three editable Word templates. Keeps channel-separated sales history, state-source verification discipline, registration steps, and filing calendars organized for timely CPA review without stating any threshold as current fact.
buyer_persona: Ecommerce founders and marketplace sellers shipping to multiple states who need a monthly monitoring routine and organized CPA handoffs.
problem_statement: Economic nexus thresholds shifted in 2024-2026 with several states dropping transaction tests, so sellers relying on remembered rules can miss crossed thresholds and face retroactive tax, penalties, and back-filing work.
outcome_statement: A reconciled monthly sales log with rolling 12-month totals, a dated verification register per state, registrations advanced with evidence, and filing periods calendared with confirmations.
whats_included: Operating guide PDF (14 sections); Excel workbook with 4 sheets: State Threshold Register, Monthly Sales by State, Registration Checklist, Filing Calendar; 3 Word templates: nexus review memo, registration action list, CPA handoff summary; README with file map.
who_not_for: Buyers seeking tax advice or filing decisions
how_to_use: Close each month from reconciled exports, read rolling totals as monitoring signals, re-verify stale state thresholds at the state source through your CPA, advance confirmed registrations, and maintain the filing calendar weekly.
limitations: General operational information only. States no specific state threshold as current fact. Rolling totals are monitoring arithmetic, not tax determinations. Channel mapping, taxability, timing, and filing positions require a CPA. Verify current threshold with the state revenue department every cycle.
disclaimer: Not tax advice, verify with a CPA; thresholds change, re-verify with each state before you register, file, or collect. Background context only: many states use $100,000 in sales as one part of their test while rules vary. Verify the current threshold with the state revenue department.

faq.q: Does this kit replace a CPA?
faq.a: No. It organizes history and questions so a CPA can advise efficiently.

faq.q: Does it list current state thresholds?
faq.a: No. It instructs verification of the current threshold with the state revenue department each cycle.
The guide exceeds 5500 words across 14 sections plus checklists and illustrative examples.
Nexus review memo, registration action list, and CPA handoff summary, all editable.

faq.q: How do marketplace sales enter the log?
faq.a: In separate columns from owned-checkout sales, with the CPA confirming which columns count per state.

changelog: 1.0 (September 2026): initial release with guide, four-sheet workbook, and three templates.
support: File and usage support by email within 7 days of purchase. Tax interpretation is not provided; consult a CPA.
